NDA 2026 (II) · Maths · Q13: sin(tan⁻¹ 0.75). V shows the triangle trick 🤖

tan θ = 3/4 → draw a 3-4-5 triangle → sin θ = 3/5.
Trap: 4/5 is cos θ, not sin θ.
